pair_blocks.requirement_contribution: Add the crossed policy analysis, guarded A100 runner, focused counterexamples, and two-stage VIPER execution path.

requirements.claim: Freeze the complete 72-item product of six speakers, two recordings, three transcript conditions, and clean and degraded audio, with alpha 1 and acoustic-position counts 0, 2, and 4.
Preserve every transcript embedding and append exactly the requested number of chronological mean-pooled acoustic positions.
Compare fixed, agreement-adaptive, audio-only-adaptive, and oracle allocations on held-out speakers at the same aggregate acoustic and input-position budgets, with recording-clustered uncertainty.

Retain one VIPER run that observes the A100 measurement stage, binds its result bytes, and recomputes both learned policies, every allocation, budget, contrast, cell summary, and bootstrap value in a separate verification stage.

acceptance_conditions: Every speaker and recording contains all six transcript-by-audio cells, actors 01 through 04 form the training split, and actors 05 and 06 form the held-out split.
The model, Transformers revision, dataset archive, selected WAV digests, prompt, noise transform, alpha, and position grid equal their frozen values.
The shared candidate assembler retains the transcript array byte-for-byte and appends exactly zero, two, or four acoustic rows.
The A100 stage asserts the same transcript slice before invoking the Thinker.
Both learned policies fit only actors 01 through 04 and never read held-out KL values during allocation.
The audio-only policy uses one score per recording and audio-quality group and selects complete three-transcript groups.
All four policies spend 48 acoustic positions and the same aggregate input positions across the 24 held-out items.
The result contains per-recording and per-actor contrasts plus all 256 deterministic recording-cluster bootstrap means for both primary comparisons.
The measurement result names the exact run-source commit and reports the CUDA device and compute capability observed by VIPER.
VIPER supplies the measurement artifact directly to the verification stage and the verification report records its SHA-256 digest.
The retained Git audit archive contains every run, stage, attempt, invocation, journal, log, artifact, measurement, and verification record referenced by the terminal result.

change_summary: Add the complete transcript-quality by audio-quality experiment and two equal-budget learned allocation policies.
Preserve transcript embeddings while measuring zero, two, and four chronological mean-pooled acoustic positions at alpha one.
Run the A100 measurement and independent CPU recomputation as connected VIPER stages and retain the complete audit graph.
plan.deviation_summary: The pilot allocates across independent RAVDESS items rather than among several transcript segments in one prompt. It tests the allocation mechanism without claiming publication-level generalization or end-to-end context-window savings.
